long_biography.plain_text:
Jimmy Eric Whited developed an auto-insurance business around local agents serving drivers in the nonstandard market. His Miami-based Windhaven group combined a property-and-casualty carrier with underwriting, claims and distribution affiliates. He held the Florida carrier through a wholly owned corporate chain. He also held a majority interest in the family vehicle behind the Texas insurer. The network expanded its policy reach through independent agencies rather than relying solely on direct sales.

The Florida insurer was found insolvent and placed into liquidation in 2020; its Texas counterpart also entered receivership. That outcome does not by itself establish Whited's personal finances, but it means the historic title of founder and chief executive cannot be treated as a current operating post. His present principal private assets and businesses have not been established. His wife Rebecca has a separately documented charitable profile, not an evidenced executive or shareholder role in Windhaven.
